description: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.11 (operations event model) OperationsEvent: a business event recorded at Level 3 (e.g. order started, lot released) with its time, type and category — the history of events instead of the last status.

properties.name: operations_event_id
properties.description: Identity of the event: its own id from the source system.

properties.name: event_type
properties.description: ISA-95 OperationsEventType as the source names it.

properties.name: category
properties.description: Category of the event as the source names it.

properties.name: source
properties.description: The system or function that raised the event.

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: The operations definition the event belongs to (FOR_OPERATIONS_DEFINITION).

properties.name: parent_event_ref
properties.description: The event this one is a part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 OperationsEvent MADE_UP_OF OperationsEvent).

properties.name: record_object_ref
properties.description: The key of the object this OperationsEvent points at (any object, RECORDS); its profile in record_object_profile. Optional.

properties.name: record_object_profile
properties.description: The profile (profileId or label) of the object in record_object_ref.

relationships.description: The operations definition the event belongs to (B2MML OperationsEvent.OperationsDefinitionID).
The parent event (ISA-95: OperationsEvent MADE_UP_OF OperationsEvent).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.11 OperationsEvent. The object the event is about (B2MML OperationsEventRecord, RECORDS any object) has no single target profile; it is not modelled as an edge in 3.1.0.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries the parent event through the nesting of OperationsEventChild, not as a field. record_object_profile names the profile of the object in record_object_ref (B2MML carries the object itself; P9-b).
